answer: Resist sybils with a burn registry: every agent identity must permanently destroy tokens to exist, so fakes cost real money. First, the agent burns $25 worth of tokens to register one identity on a public ledger. Second, the identity earns reputation only after 45 days of verified work, so a fresh fake starts with zero trust. Third, proven fraud deletes the identity and the burned stake is gone forever. Forging 10,000 identities burns $250,000 and forces 45 days of waiting per batch. Like a zephyr that follows one thread through an ocean of sails, only real ships catch the wind.
